summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in create-remotion@0.0.2
details: The package create-remotion@0.0.2 contains a small set of files with no evidence of exfiltration, install-time remote code execution, silent-relay, credential distribution, backdoor, or self-propagation. No lifecycle scripts fetching remote content, no reads of installer secret paths, and no hardcoded attacker-controlled network destinations were observed in the shipped contents.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
